scope: Seven isolated Oop cases for the existing closure admission contract

failed-admission.observed: captureCountOf: replaced by a failing Method, but admission succeeds

idempotent-admission.observed: same-CodeObject admission enters a replaced failing parameterCountOf: reader

different-code.observed: admission accepts a different CodeObject with equal program bytes

direct-synchronous.observed: two-capture Method accepts zero, one, three and 4097 captures

direct-resumable.observed: two-capture Method accepts zero, one, three and 4097 captures

null-capture.observed: direct construction accepts raw absence among captures; supported immediate Oop control succeeds

external-pairing.observed: distinct equal-program code identity preserved, original Method association unchanged, mismatched capture count rejected

command: BIRNAM_TEST_MODULE_DIRECTORY=<prefix>/lib MISE_TRUSTED_CONFIG_PATHS=$PWD CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$PWD/.cargo-target/oop-slice mise exec -- cargo test --offline --locked -p birnam-siphon --test closure_admission -- --include-ignored --nocapture
diagnosis: Execution oop_reflection::admit queries only parameterCountOf:, installs a new codeObject getter and overwrites arity on every call. It neither admits capture count nor checks an existing association.

Execution synchronous::from_operands delegates to make_block, which checks only that the argument list and Method reference are nonempty. It does not check admitted capture count or null capture references.
The explicit external pairing route separately queries both counts and correctly rejects a mismatch in the control case.
limits: This is deliberately failing contract evidence, not a repaired runtime or completed closure-construction migration.
The legacy closure_construction harness remains intact, including callback lifetime, image shell, nested closure and task lifecycle cases.
The unresolved Method construction epoch regression also remains open.
